items.title: Police probe Jeffrey Epstein’s time spent at Balmoral with Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor
items.brief: Scottish police are investigating the time convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein spent with Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor at Balmoral, a private royal estate in Scotland which is a favored retreat for the monarchy.

items.title: Evacuations begin in occupied Ukrainian town as Melania Trump-brokered ceasefire holds
items.brief: Hundreds of people from an occupied town in southern Ukraine who survived months without basic supplies are set to be evacuated on Friday under a ceasefire agreement negotiated by first lady Melania Trump .

items.title: Big Oil is raking in huge profits. Shareholders like Trump are cashing in. You’re paying for it with high gas prices.
items.brief: Big Oil minted big money as the Iran war delivered American drivers the highest gas prices on record for the third quarter.

items.title: World’s largest crypto exchange hit by suspected North Korean hack in world’s largest heist
items.brief: Binance, the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange, suspended withdrawals after hackers broke into its digital wallets and stole $6 billion in what appears to be the biggest crypto heist ever.
